hypotheses.hypothesis: No service showed errors during the time window from 22:55Z to 23:20Z on 2026-10-10, based on the absence of error counts in the spans for any service name when filtering by status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR.
hypotheses.evidence: At 23:12:00 the shop's SERVER spans failed at 0.55/s summed over all services (flagd's own stream excluded), so `== 0` returns nothing. The agent's queries used span_name="*", which PromQL reads as the literal value `*` and which matches no series: it read the absence of its own typo as the absence of errors.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The query for checkout service errors returned no results: `traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout", span_name="*", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}`.
hypotheses.evidence: Read as the claim it makes (checkout had no errors), the data contradicts it: checkout's failed SERVER spans ran at 0.015/s at 23:12:00 (16 % of orders), so `== 0` returns nothing. The query it quotes returned nothing only because span_name="*" matches no span.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Given the absence of error metrics across all relevant services, the most likely cause of the reported checkout errors at 23:11:09Z is a transient or external factor—such as a temporary network issue, client-side JavaScript error, or a misaligned page load—rather than a failure at any of the backend services as monitored.
hypotheses.evidence: Its testable part is "rather than a failure at any of the backend services as monitored". product-catalog's GetProduct failed at 0.13/s over the 5 minutes to 23:12:00, so the prediction "no backend failure" (< 0.001/s) returns nothing: a monitored backend service did fail. The alternative it offers (network, client-side JavaScript) has no support in any series it read.
